biggest_catch: The full $55 per side requires real payroll — your friend must route their actual paycheck twice ($100+ each time) within 60 days. Opening the account alone only pays $5.
catches: $5 per side is paid when the friend opens a MoneyLion Spend account with your referral code; the extra $50 per side requires the friend's recurring direct deposit of $100+ to appear at least twice within 60 days of account opening.

Direct deposit must be employer, payroll-provider, or benefits-payer ACH — bank ACH transfers, PayPal/Cash App/Venmo P2P, trial deposits, mobile check, tax refunds, stimulus/economic-impact payments, and cash deposits do NOT qualify.
Friend must be a new MoneyLion user with a direct personal non-commercial relationship to you; anyone who has had a MoneyLion account before is ineligible.
The friend must enter the referral code at registration — it cannot be added later.
Rewards are credited within 14 days of completing the required actions; form (cash or Reward Points) is at MoneyLion's discretion.
MoneyLion may change or terminate the promotion at any time; promotion began December 20, 2024 with no fixed end date.
